summary: TPG RE Finance Trust filed an 8-K reporting that on October 2, 2026 its wholly owned Cayman and Delaware subsidiaries closed a $762.5 million CRE CLO (TRTX 2026-FL8), co-issuing Class A, A-S and B floating-rate notes due 2044 under a new indenture with Wilmington Trust as trustee and Computershare as note administrator. Class A totals $600 million at Benchmark plus 1.35% (plus 0.25% after July 2032), rated AAA by Fitch and Morningstar DBRS, with a 3.12-year expected weighted average life. This is a routine financing/off-balance-sheet securitization, not a special situation; watch warehouse paydown, retained subordination and leverage.
